segments.text:
V. 21.
For—He declares, which are thoſe greater Works, Raiſing the Dead, and Judging the World. The Power of quickening whom he will follows from the Power of judging. Theſe two, Quickening and Judging, are propoſed ver. 2•.22. The Acquittal of Believers, which pre-ſuppoſes Judgment, is treated of in the 24th Verſe; the Quickening ſome of the Dead, ver. 25; and the general Reſurrection, ver. 28.
